decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The class use hereby permitted shall not be open to anyone other than staff outside the hours of 09.00-19.00 hours Monday-Friday and 09.00-15.30 hours on Saturdays, and not at all on Sundays and public holidays without the further written consent of the Local planning authority.
Condition : 4 - The access doorway shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 5 - No animals are permitted to be kept at the premises outside the hours of operation
Condition : 6 - The sale of animals is not permitted at the premises
description: Change of use from Post Office use to Vetinary Surgery and pet retail use.
